sql_templates.description: Identify the latest enhanced report runs and retrieve associated stock rows.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_runs AS (
    SELECT run_id, run_ts FROM report.enhanced_runs
    WHERE run_ts > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 week'
),
latest_filtered AS (
    SELECT r.run_id, f.symbol, f.current_price
    FROM latest_runs r
    JOIN report.enhanced_filtered_stocks f
    ON r.run_id = f.run_id
)
SELECT * FROM latest_filtered;

sql_templates.name: latest_vcp_breakouts_with_fundamentals
sql_templates.template:
SELECT DISTINCT m.symbol, m.close, s.enhanced_fund_score, v.vcp_score
FROM market.equity_eod m
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON m.symbol = s.symbol AND m.trade_date = s.snapshot_date
JOIN scores.stage2_vcp_picks v ON m.symbol = v.symbol AND s.snapshot_date = v.snapshot_date
WHERE m.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
  AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
  AND v.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage2_vcp_picks)
  AND s.stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND s.trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
  AND m.close > m.week52_high * 0.9
ORDER BY v.vcp_score DESC, s.enhanced_fund_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Synthesize data into a QA checklist format.', 'Highlight candidates with potential breakouts and strong fundamentals.']
title: VCP Breakouts With Fundamentals Variant 1710
